name: zup-action
description: The official zup GitHub Action: install the zup CLI, run its build, compose, attest and publish phases, and report results

scripts.typecheck: bun check --no-script -p tsconfig.json && bun check --no-script -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.check:dist: bun run build && git diff --exit-code -- action/dist
scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun run format:check && bun test && bun run build && bun run metadata && bun run verify:runtime
